mentions.name: Damn Interesting
mentions.description: This website publishes the author's writing, accumulated over twenty years of articles. AI systems have ingested its content and are summarizing or rewriting it to siphon the site's traffic, while the certainty that every new piece will be gobbled up as well smothers the author's motivation to write more.
mentions.problem: AI models trained on the site's twenty years of writings steal its traffic by summarizing or rewriting the work, and the expectation that new writing will also be absorbed discourages further writing; the author is barely getting by.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am in a similar situation. The AIs have slurped up all of the content on my site--twenty years' worth of writings--and they are using it to ruin me.

evidence.value: I am in a similar situation. The AIs have slurped up all of the content on my site--twenty years' worth of writings--and they are using it to ruin me.
